title: Stop waking main for a worker that only paused
notes:
Since PR #176, every time a worker's turn ends the app queues a prompt into its main: '<worker> in pane <id> has finished its turn. If it sent you a report...'. A worker's turn also ends while it waits on its own background work (pr-loop, /simplify reviewers, CI), so main gets dozens of these per card, each one a full main turn spent checking pane list and saying 'still waiting' (seen 2026-11-04 on dashboard and new-crm, four in a few minutes). It costs tokens, buries real reports, and fills the user's chat.

Fix: tell main only when it means something.
- A worker that sent main a report (SendMessage) is already heard; no extra notice for that turn end.
- Otherwise notify only when the pane stays out of 'running' for a grace period (a few minutes, re-checked), so mid-task pauses never reach main; one notice per stop, not one per turn end.
- Keep a done notice for a worker that truly stopped without reporting, which is the case #176 was built for.
- Show it on the Claude screen as a compact status line rather than a user-coloured prompt bubble, so it does not read as something the user typed.
Related: card 5f5b62b8 carries the same comment; close that part there. The rule (grace period, report seen, one notice per stop) is a small module with a test (workflow-rule-2). docs/workers decision updated.
